reviewed.reason: 'این کار مبارک باشد' (may this work be blessed) uses باشد as the fixed optative expression its own entry is authored for - lx-0287's own example, 'سال نو مبارک باشد', is the identical construction; the collision is with بودن (to be, lx-0096)'s generated 3rd-person subjunctive 'باشد', the same word under a different entry, not a different one.

'بازی می‌کنند' (they play) uses بازی as the noun half of the light-verb compound 'بازی کردن' (to play); the collision is with باختن (to lose, lx-0474)'s 2nd-person-singular present 'بازی' (تو می‌بازی), which does not fit before 'می‌کنند'.

'سال گذشته' (last year) uses گذشته attributively for 'past/last' - the same word as گذشتن (to pass, lx-0621)'s participle, so the noun entry's gloss already covers this reading; not a different-meaning collision like cuina/cuinar.

'... خورد است' (... is small) is the adjective; the collision is with خوردن (to eat/drink, lx-0091)'s 3rd-person-singular past 'خورد' (he ate), which does not fit as a predicate after 'برای همه شاگردان'.
